name: repocouncil
description: Multi-agent GitHub PR review system for the Qwen Cloud hackathon.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @repocouncil/shared && npm run build -w @repocouncil/api && npm run build -w @repocouncil/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @repocouncil/shared && npm run typecheck -w @repocouncil/api && npm run typecheck -w @repocouncil/web
